profileText: Computer Science Engineering student in final semester, focused on innovation, continuous improvement, and the development of technological solutions. I stand out for my proactivity, adaptability, and teamwork skills, with an analytical approach to problem-solving.Experience in development using Python, PHP, and Java with Spring Boot for backend, as well as React for web development and Flutter for mobile applications. Skilled in Git and GitHub for version control and project management.

jobs.description: I performed basic troubleshooting of technical issues, supported the configuration of equipment and applications, and followed up on incidents until they were resolved or escalated to the appropriate team. I also logged cases in the support system and provided assistance through different support channels.
